_meta.purpose: Courier / fetch errands for the v26 narration overhaul. An NPC in `fromCity` asks the player to deliver an item to `toCity` (kind:'deliver') or recover a route-dropped item (kind:'recover', paid off back in `fromCity`). Mirrored by DEFAULT_STORY_ERRANDS in battle.html (offline fallback). Reward sizes are MAINTAINER-OWNED balance numbers — tune freely. reward can be { gold }, { ultra } (Ultra Balls), or { item:{id,count} }.

offerLines: A foreman flags you down at the gate, soot to the elbows.
"You’re headed up the pass? Take this ledger to the tutor’s shop in the next town. My courier quit. Pay’s good."
deliverLines: The move tutor takes the ledger, reads two lines, and snorts.
"He still owes me from the spring. Here—for your trouble." Coins, counted twice.

offerLines: A student catches you mid-stride, arms full of paper.
"Please—my sister’s at the lake resort and she needs these notes before finals. I can’t leave campus. You look fast."
deliverLines: Poolside, the sister flips through the notes and exhales.
"He actually sent them. Tell him—no, don’t tell him anything. Here, take this. Hit the tables on me."

offerLines: The Safari warden stops you at the gate, embarrassed.
"Dropped my field pouch somewhere on the lakeside road this morning. Bring it back and the next Ball’s on the house."
deliverLines: You hand over the pouch, mud and all. The warden checks it twice.
"Everything’s here. You’re alright, kid. Take this—you’ll want it up the climb."
